stage70_optional_control_note: Optional stage70 comparison uses stage70 per-run argv for exact common-knob matching (K parsed from stage70 +shared-read-quantum, the same actual quantum flag as stage72; Rinterval/Bdelay/PTEdelay/first/backpressure/a-dst-offset/write-prefetch/naturalbytes/physicalbypass/sourcecutover). natural-trace/requiretestpath/buildmode-specific flags and derived E are excluded from equality. Only exact-knob matches are listed.
budget0_common_prefix_independent_note: Budget0 common-prefix independent route adds one AR versus an ordinary full-A independent control. This audit makes no Pareto-superiority or novel-algorithm claim.
aw_count_note: Odd-E routes may have non-128 AW counts. This audit requires actual W beats/byte guards and does not invent a fixed-128 AW count for every route.
scope: behavioral-DDR real RTL; eight owned sources plus per-budget executable snapshots; external vendor dependency tree is not a hermetic snapshot.
